name: relay-mast
title: Comms relay mast
usage: Relay stations across the campaign (M3-M27): scenery companion to the CommsRelay target.

noText.note: Textures are baked from noise, grids and masks only; no letters, numbers, words, call signs or codes in mesh or texture.

noLogosOrBrands.note: No company, product or brand marks; colour fields and wear only.

noRealMilitaryInsignia.note: No roundels, flags, national or unit markings; shape is an original design, not a copy of any real vehicle or building.

noFaces.note: No faces, figures or face-like arrangements.

noSuggestiveShapes.note: Ordinary hard-surface or natural forms reviewed in all four previews.

noGoreOrWeaponsGlorification.note: No gore, blood or damage imagery; at most empty pylons or a covered deck mount.

originalDesign.note: Authored procedurally in tools/assets from original dimensions; no third-party meshes or scans.
